While the soldiers were guarding Thy tomb
Having laid aside all earthly hope
Let us assemble with the disciples
When the stone had been sealed
Thou Who wast lifted up upon the Cross
O Lord, the cup of torment
For the deeds done by me
Thou Who didst put to death

Максиміа́новыми ласка́нми не ꙋ҆клони́всѧ: Хв҃ыми же словесы̀ мꙋ́жествовавъ, и҆́долское ка́пище въ ѻ҆гнѝ и҆спепели́лъ є҆сѝ, страда́льчески побѣди́въ до́брѣ проти́вника, прⷣте́кши преше́лъ є҆сѝ ѻ҆́гнь ꙗ҆́кѡже въ во́дꙋ. тѣ́мже досто́йнѡ въздаѧ́ніе по́двигѡ, и҆сточа́еши и҆сцѣле́ніа страстоте́рпче Ѳео́дѡре, мл҃исѧ Хꙋ Бг҃ꙋ, съгрѣше́ніемъ ѡ҆ставле́ніе дарова́ти, пра́зднꙋющымъ любо́вію ст҃ꙋю па́мѧть тво̑
Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us
What shall we call you, O holy ones
Great is the power of Thy martyrs
Beholding the beauty of thy virginity
Great is the power of Thy Cross, O Lord
O Lord, at the time of Moses
An Angel of the First Rank
They weighed thirty pieces of silver
On the right hand of the Savior
Having risen on the third day
O Lord, though Thou didst stand before the tribunal
Thou art risen from the tomb
Thou didst arise from the tomb
Archangelically let us sing, ye faithful
Lord, in the days of Moses
Lord, [standing] at the tomb of Lazarus

invocations.normalized_rubric: *The Blameless (Kathisma 17). Hypakoe of the Tone, and a reading from the Gospel. Polyeleos, and the Sessional Hymns of the Feast all once; Glory, and now and ever: of the Feast, and reading 1. Gradual Antiphons of the Tone. Prokeimenon, and Gospel of the Feast. "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ." Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast. Canon: Resurrectional on 4; and of the Cross on 4; and of the Feast on 6. But if the Canon of the Cross has a Resurrectional Troparion in every Ode, then the Resurrectional Canon of the Tone is omitted; and the Heirmos of the Canon of the Cross is sung twice, and the Resurrectional Troparion twice that is in the Canon of the Cross, and the remaining Troparia of the Cross on 4, and of the Feast on 6. Katavasia of the Feast: Heirmos: "I shall open my mouth," both choirs together. After Ode 3: Kontakion of the Cross, and Ikos, and Sessional Hymn of the Cross; Glory, and now and ever: of the Feast; Reading of the Feast. After Ode 6: Kontakion of the Feast, and Ikos, and the Prologue. At Ode 9: we sing: "More honorable than the Cherubim." Exapostilarion: Resurrectional; Glory: of the Cross; Now and ever: of the Feast.
